headline: Gate.io CEO Emphasizes Cold Storage Security Standards for Crypto Exchanges
summary: Gate.io CEO Lin Han stated that crypto exchanges must maintain sufficient cold storage assets to cover customer balances in the event of a hack. The exchange is currently undergoing an independent audit to verify its reserves.
why: Crypto exchanges are central intermediaries in the digital asset market. Security protocols and proof-of-reserves are critical for maintaining investor trust and regulatory compliance in the volatile cryptocurrency sector.

impacts.name: Gate.io
impacts.why: The statement outlines internal security policies rather than a direct market-moving event.
